continuity: The Skeleton Warlord's Commander's Rally strengthens the Strength, Agility, and Magic of monsters under his command and raises their Levels by five.

The Skeleton Warlord accepts a contract with Taekyung to supply as many Skeletons as requested while retaining his titles and nominal authority; he rationalizes the arrangement as protecting his soldiers rather than submitting.
The Warlord had no Magic Gems, and his sudden increase in magical power somehow allowed him to escape the black wizard's previously absolute control; neither he nor Taekyung knows the cause.
Taekyung considers testing whether a human can absorb a Magic Gem, contrary to established academic consensus, but the attempt does not occur before the Warlord detects intruders.
The Warlord senses other humans entering the Black Forest from the south near the Gate entrance, and Taekyung identifies them as his friends.
plot: Taekyung turns the Skeleton Warlord's resurrection ability into an EXP harvest. He makes the Warlord activate Commander's Rally, gathers the newly raised Skeletons, destroys them with Spear Energy, and collects the resulting EXP, Magic Gems, and Equipment.

After arguing over the terms of a contract, the Skeleton Warlord agrees to retain his position as master of the Black Forest and commander of the undead army while serving as the Peace Guild's EXP factory manager. He later reveals that the black wizard directly summoned him, yet a sudden unexplained surge in magical power recently freed him from the summoner's control. Near the end of the harvest, he senses intruders entering the forest, and Taekyung heads toward the Gate entrance with the Warlord's skull.
translation_decisions: Render 경험치 공장장 as “EXP factory manager” and 친인파 as “pro-human”; retain the Warlord's archaic, indignant voice against Taekyung's sarcastic colloquial voice.
Render 우렁각시 as “snail bride” and explain the Korean folktale reference in a footnote.
Render the 남아일언 중천금 pun as “A man's word is worth a thousand pieces of gold,” followed by the Warlord's “A man who lost his mama?” misinterpretation.

active_continuity: The Peace Guild remains committed to its members and continues expanding through selective Hunter recruitment, generous support, and exclusive Gate rights.
Taekyung leads accelerated training raids for Peace Guild recruits, with Kim Jinsoo acting as the third-week trainees' operational deputy.
The A-rank Black Wizard's Black Forest contains a large undead army and was ruled by a black wizard or necromancer.
The leading Skeleton Knight evolved into a speaking Level 105 Skeleton Warlord, a former human knight who lost his memories and became the Black Forest's new ruler.
The Skeleton Warlord commands the undead and can gather more than a thousand subordinates by searching the Black Forest.
Taekyung used One Annihilation against the Warlord's tightly packed army, destroyed hundreds of Skeletons, gained a level, and recovered from Exhaustion through the System.
Taekyung now uses the Warlord's resurrection and command abilities to farm EXP, with the Warlord serving as the Peace Guild's EXP factory manager under contract.
Commander's Rally enhances the commanded monsters' Strength, Agility, and Magic and raises their Levels by five.
The Warlord's sudden surge in magical power freed him from the black wizard's control despite having no Magic Gems; the cause remains unknown.
Taekyung has completed repeated training raids without trainee deaths so far, though injuries have occurred.
Team Leader Choi and three other senior Guild members remain focused on cultivating the Jin Family's Cultivation Technique.
Choi Minwoo reached Four Stars in the Jin Family's Cultivation Technique after one week and possesses a hidden mass of internal energy equivalent to one jiazi.
Choi Minwoo suspects his grandfather caused or placed the hidden energy within him, but he does not know what was done.
The four practitioners are training in secret inside Choi Minwoo's heavily secured private training room.
News reports described Taekyung as isolated bait inside the Black Forest while facing a Named Monster and hundreds of Skeletons.
The Hunter Association's rescue response was delayed despite more than thirty A-rank Hunters and an Ares Guild contingent gathering at the Gate.
Choi Minwoo and the other three Peace Guild members reached the Gate and demanded permission to enter and save Taekyung.
The Seoul Branch President tried to block the Peace Guild and showed conspicuous deference to Go Jun.
Humans generally cannot absorb Magic Gems because their demonic qi is poisonous, but Taekyung has begun questioning that consensus.
The Warlord detected intruders entering the Black Forest from the south near the Gate entrance, and Taekyung identified them as his friends.
open_questions: Who actually taught Jin Taekyung the Jin Family's Cultivation Technique?
What history led Lee Jungryong to regard the unrelated Cheon Taemin as his older brother?
How extensive are Ares Guild's undisclosed forces beyond its officially registered Hunters?
Will Im Kkeokjeong's reattached arms and trauma recover sufficiently for him to return to Hunter work?
What is the origin of the large qi mass in Team Leader Choi's dantian, and what did his grandfather do to him?
What prevented Taekyung from completing his breakthrough into the Supreme Peak realm?
What caused the Skeleton Warlord's sudden magical-power increase and unusual evolution, and what will result from Taekyung's contract with it?
Who are the intruders entering the Black Forest, and what will happen when they meet Taekyung and the Warlord?
